conclusion: Model exceeds every station: hourly bias +17 to +32 µg/m³; hourly r 0.25-0.53.
Day-to-day variation is captured better: daily r 0.54-0.82.
An observed/model ratio fitted on days 1-15 reduced MAE on days 16-30 at all four stations, but one wet-season month cannot calibrate the dry season.
Use the forecast for relative higher/lower periods, labelled as an external model; do not present raw values as expected street-level concentrations.
